title: Planet of the Vapes Pax Dosing Capsules
description:
Dosing capsules for PAX vaporizers

Experience precise and hassle-free sessions with dosing capsules for your PAX dry herb vaporizer. Pack multiple capsules and chain sessions together with zero downtime, or use them for consistent doses every time. With your herbs contained inside these little pods, sessions are mess-free and promote a cleaner, fresher PAX vaporizer.

Comes with four dosing capsules.

Just remove the PAX oven screen and place the capsule inside.

POTV has the best value

Vaporists of all levels consider dosing capsules a must-have accessory. We’re always striving to keep the scene new and exciting with improvements on our favorite vapes, so we developed a set for PAX 2, PAX 3, and PAX Plus users.

It’s important that we create a set that’s accessible and affordable to our customers. That’s why we priced our PAX dosing capsules at nearly half the cost of the competition – to provide you with a high-quality product that meets your needs, without breaking the bank.

Faster, easier sessions wherever you are

Carry a set of prepacked dosing capsules and skip the loading times altogether! Load one in, dump it out when you’re done, and quickly swap in another one in seconds. You don’t even need to turn the oven off! No more awkward moments as you fiddle around with your grinder and loose herbs.

(Be careful when removing the capsules, they’re HOT!)

Same great sessions

Our dosing capsules enhance your sessions without sacrificing performance. Each one is perforated with little holes to maintain a satisfying vaping experience with high-quality vapor production, optimal heating, and consistent airflow.

Consistent doses every time

Keep your dose consistent every time with dosing capsules. As its name suggests, dosing capsules are a convenient way to pack and vape the same amount of dry herbs every time, whether you’re at home or on the go.

Preheat for the best results

For the very best results, place your filled capsule in the oven and let it heat soak at temperature for 15 to 30 seconds before you take your first hit. Because dosing capsules take a little longer to heat up, sessions will turn out a little lighter if you dive in too soon. Give it a little time for the strongest hits.

Keep your PAX cleaner

A clean vape is a happy vape, so grab a set of dosing capsules to keep yours fresher for longer. With these little pods, your herbs never come into contact with the oven. Messes are kept inside each capsule, which helps keep your oven cleaner for longer.

Compatibility

These dosing dosing capsules are compatible with the following PAX devices:

PAX 2
PAX 3
PAX Plus

NOT compatible with PAX Mini.

Backed by POTV Experts

While they’re not an official product of PAX, these food-grade stainless steel dosing capsules have been designed, tested, and approved by our team of product experts and engineers. They are guaranteed to fit your PAX dry herb vaporizer.

Just remove the PAX oven screen and place the capsule inside.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.

Shop more PAX Parts and Accessories

POTV PAX Dosing Capsules FAQs

How do you load the capsule?
Load your PAX capsule just like you would the PAX vaporizer. Use a medium to fine grind and fill the capsule (a coarse grind or whole herbs works too).

You can load it loosely or pack it tightly depending on your vape style. Use a loose pack for longer draws and a tight pack for little sips.

Attach the lid to the capsule after you have filled it with herbs.

How do you put the capsule in?
Remove the oven lid and take out the oven screen at the bottom.

Load the packed capsule “top up” into the PAX oven so you can read the word “POTV”.

Put the oven lid back on and turn the PAX on.

How do you take out the capsule?
Take the oven lid off, and turn the PAX upside down to dump the capsule out while it is still warm but not hot.

How do you clean the capsule?
Once the capsule is cool, open it up and dump/scrape out the leftover herbs.

When it’s time for a deeper clean, soak it in rubbing in alcohol and rinse with warm water.

What to avoid
Load the capsule with the word “POTV” facing up, or it can get stuck in the oven. The PAX oven has a slight taper, so the capsule needs to be loaded in the correct orientation.
